additionalInformation: The item's attributes grants the following additional bonuses:
480 mana, 2 mana regeneration and 4% flat base magic resistance.
28 main attack damage to universal heroes.
The projectile speed bonus only affects attack projectiles.
description: Warning: There is no antidote if picked up by the wrong end.
tips: Attacks from Parasma can reduce magic resistance by 20%, therefore this item is very effective on heroes who have any way of dealing of magical damage as it will boost the damage they will deal: Ancient Apparition, Batrider, Broodmother, Dark Willow, Dawnbreaker, Death Prophet, Disruptor, Enigma, Gyrocopter, Huskar, Jakiro, Lina, Luna, Naga Siren, Outworld Destroyer, Puck, Pugna, Queen of Pain_new, Razor, Rubick, Shadow Demon, Shadow Fiend, Shadow Shaman, Storm Spirit, Silencer, Tinker, Vengeful Spirit, Venomancer, Void Spirit, Visage, Windranger.

abilities.description: Causes your next attack to have true strike, apply a poison for 4 seconds, slowing by 25% and dealing 0.75x your intelligence as damage every second.
Your attacks reduce the enemy's Magic resistance by 20% for 4 seconds.

name: Parasma
